fields.description: The host this export came from. One row per (host, observed epoch).
fields.label: Server

fields.description: Boat's monotonic observed epoch for this snapshot (spec/33 §2.5). Bumped on every observed change, so it orders snapshots for one host and is what a later CAS write is matched against with If-Match.
fields.label: Observed Epoch

fields.description: The export's own taken_at — when the host observed this, not when Atlas ingested it.
fields.label: Observed At

fields.description: The Boat binary running on the host when this export was taken. Every unit on that host is this build, so desired-vs-observed version drift is ordinary observed state rather than a separate bookkeeping channel (spec/33 §5).
fields.label: Boat Version

fields.description: How many ways this host and the DB disagreed at this epoch. 0 means the mirror matched.
fields.label: Drift Count

fields.description: How many VMs the host observed at this epoch.
fields.label: Virtual Machine Count

fields.description: Each disagreement between the DB and the host, stated once: {virtual_machine, kind, desired, observed}. Reported, never acted on — Atlas surfaces drift, Boat's reconciler is what drives observed towards desired (spec/33 §1).
fields.label: Drift

fields.description: The whole GET /export document, verbatim: every VM's observed doc, host facts, LV inventory, unit liveness and every fence epoch. Kept for debugging, mirror rebuild and drift forensics — never read as authority.
fields.label: Export Document
